title: Compare To Zero
text: Determine how signal compares to zero, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Operator} sets Logical operator; {Output data type} sets the data type and {Enable zero-crossing detection} selects to enable zero-crossing detection. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of the output boolean (default) | uint8

params.name: Enable zero-crossing detection
params.values: Select to enable zero-crossing detection on (default) | off
